notes:
MINING-MISS-VERIFY-R3D (plant-finder): ruled on the 46 R3-D auditor plants in r3d-verify.json (on-road dump-body makers already removed). The ledger was searched in plants.csv by name, parent, id, website and city, and every ledger/inbox and ledger/audit JSON was grepped for earlier decisions. Results: 21 already_in_ledger, 15 verified_miss, 8 unverified, 2 out_of_definition, 0 not_a_plant.
Of the 15 verified misses, 2 have welding shown (CID Denton: Welding department on the application form; Star Industries: Welding listed as a hiring area). 13 are base with prospect_test unknown (welding not shown; Caterpillar Clayton / Pemberton precedent).
Boundary handling: 9 are compact or skid-steer attachment makers kept as boundary rows (R2 ruling): CID, Omni, Stinger, Top Dog, Quick Attach (city-level record, no street address), plus the lifting-led Cornerstone, Haugen, Star and Kenco, which state a skid-steer or excavator attachment line. Grouser is tractor-led with a stated skid-steer dozer line and is flagged for a coordinator ruling.
The other 5 are in definition without the boundary flag: USA Attachments, AIM and D&E (excavator attachments), Young's Machine (underground haul trucks) and Hammersmith Horton (shared Vail attachment work).
Hammersmith Horton is a second plant of an already-found company (Vail Holton). The coordinator may count it apart from the misses.
Relationship: every verified miss is a lookalike of Mine Rite (attachments or bodies sold as products; underground mining vehicles under the consultation 9 rule).
Leads:
- Erskine Attachments, 920 Airport Road, Fosston MN (ECHO 110070340250). It may be or share Quick Attach's Fosston plant.
- CID's second Denton facility.
- Stinger's 'Minnesota facilities'.
- OSHA records seen in passing, not on the R3-D list: Diamond Attachments, Atoka OK (333120, 27); Prime Attachments, Garfield MN (Skid Steer Central, 333992, 34); ABI Attachments, Mishawaka IN (333111, 68).
- MEC Heber Springs: Caterpillar SQEP and 7SWE weld certification (The Fabricator).
- Artisan Vehicle Systems: OSHA record at 742 Pancho Rd, Camarillo (106).
No headcount was written. The CID OSHA record 2921275 fails the single-candidate gate because a contractor record, WGS CID Plant, shares the address.
Web searches used: 1 (Quick Attach / Erskine; result used for discovery only).
Where one page carries two clauses of a field, the second row's source_url carries a #x2/#x3 fragment.
Split of the 15 verified misses:
- core, 5: USA Attachments, AIM, D&E, Young's Machine, Hammersmith Horton;
- compact/skid-steer boundary, 5: CID, Omni, Stinger, Top Dog, Quick Attach;
- lifting-led boundary, 4: Cornerstone, Haugen, Star, Kenco;
- tractor-led boundary, 1: Grouser.
The lifting-led and tractor-led rows rest on this agent's triage rule ('in when a skid-steer or excavator attachment line is stated'), not a logged coordinator ruling. The nearest logged calls (telehandlers, JCB San Antonio) went the other way.
Hammersmith Horton is the auditor's 'Vail Products, Horton' row. Vail's Holton plant is already p-vail-holton-ks, so the miss count is 15 counting Horton as a miss, 14 if it is treated as already found.
Under strict rulings (no lifting-led, no tractor-led, no Horton) the count is 9.
